Angel - Jello Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 1:13am

Ingredients




1 box angel food cake mix
1 pt. frozen or fresh strawberries
2 (3 oz.) boxes strawberry Jello
2 cups powdered sugar
1/2 stick butter
1 teaspoon vanilla
2 tablespoons milk

Preparation

1 Prepare angel food cake according to directions on box. 2 While cake is baking make Jello according to package directions. When Jello is firm but not solid, add drained strawberries. Set aside. 3 When cake is cool, cut about 1 inch layer from top of cake. Make a ditch in the large part of the cake. Break up these pieces and place in the Jello mixture you have already set aside. Be careful not to go too close to the edge when making the ditch. Pour the Jello and cake mixture back into the ditch of the cake, and place the top portion of the cake bacon on. 4 Ice with butter icing above. Keep refrigerated to keep Jello solid.
